sentence_stem: Look at those dark clouds. Take an umbrella, because
correct_completion: it is going to rain soon.
full_sentence: Look at those dark clouds. Take an umbrella, because it is going to rain soon.
acceptable_variants: it is going to pour soon.
it is going to start raining in a minute.

options.why_wrong: The stem describes dark clouds, so bright sunshine does not give a reason for taking an umbrella.
This is past tense and does not explain why you need an umbrella now.

options.text: it is going to rain soon.
we went to the beach yesterday.
options.why_wrong: This is about the past and has no logical connection to the reason for the umbrella.

grammar_focus: Future: going to for predictions based on present evidence
explanation: Going to is used for a prediction based on evidence that can be seen now, such as dark clouds in the sky. Ukrainian speakers may choose a simple future form in this position, but in English the present evidence makes going to the natural choice.
translation: Подивіться на ті темні хмари. Візьміть парасольку, бо незабаром піде дощ.
